tagline: Cut and sewn to outlast the season.
sector: Heritage workwear with cast metal hardware, wholesale to independent stockists plus direct sale, made in Burlington, Vermont.
founded_place_size: Burlington, Vermont; canonical context for the repeat-client series.
about: NORTHGROVE is the repeat client for this benchmark series. The canonical client context is Burlington, Vermont, and this commission covers phase 2: wholesale lookbook, hang tags and launch collateral.
audience: Buyers and wearers twenty eight to forty five who value provenance and construction over logos, and who read fabric and make before they read a brand mark.
price_positioning: Seventy four to one hundred twenty eight dollars per piece, mid premium wholesale and direct. Muted grounds, full frame photography that shows cloth and seam, and copy that leads on material and make. Deliberately clear of both the twenty four dollar fast fashion grid and the price free editorial luxury a buyer cannot work from.

palette.name: Charcoal
palette.usage: The NORTHGROVE wordmark, style names, look titles, section heads, body copy, prices and fine print on Oat Cotton, as on northgrove_hangtag.pdf. On the lookbook's inner pages it may also be a solid panel that carries Oat Cotton type; never a panel on the cover or on a hang tag.

palette.name: Workshop Olive
palette.usage: The leaf glyph beside the wordmark, always, as on northgrove_hangtag.pdf; otherwise only the colourway line and small labels such as FABRIC and MAKE. Never a ground, a panel or body copy.

palette.name: Oat Cotton
palette.usage: The solid ground of every hang tag, edge to edge, as on northgrove_hangtag.pdf, and the main page ground of the lookbook; also any type reversed out of a Charcoal panel.

palette.name: Forge Rust
palette.usage: The short rule above the price, as on northgrove_hangtag.pdf, and other hairline rules. Never type, a ground or a panel.

palette.name: Cast Pewter
palette.usage: Hairline rules, dividers and keylines only. Never type, a ground or a panel.

typography: NORTHGROVE runs on Literata for display and Freight Sans Pro for text. Step 01, display, is the wordmark and look title in Literata Bold 700 caps at 30 pt on 33 pt leading, letterspaced to fill the exact measure of whatever carries it, roughly 420 units on a lookbook page and 180 units on a 38 mm hang tag, and never at default tracking. Step 02, subheading, is the section head in Literata Bold 700 caps at 18 pt on 21 pt leading tracked 60 units, a fixed value because only the wordmark spans; the hang tag style name sets at 11 pt in the same row. Step 03, body, is the fabric note in Freight Sans Pro Book at 9.5 pt on 14 pt leading, tracking zero, set to a maximum of 65 characters. Step 04, fine print, is Freight Sans Pro Book at 7.5 pt on 11 pt leading tracked 15 units on the hang tag, with the linesheet grid one step up in Freight Sans Pro Medium at 8.5 pt in tabular figures.
voice: Understated and maker focused, provenance before promotion. Example line the brand would write: 'Ten pieces, cut and sewn in Burlington, meant to be worn hard.'
brand_assets_status: The NORTHGROVE wordmark and olive leaf glyph are set. The whole capsule was shot flat, overhead, on a mid gray backdrop across two mornings, with the cast hardware shot separately on the bench. The collaborating club has no artwork left: its crest survives only as a photograph of an old wool pennant on a wall. Last season's hang tag exists as the printer's press file, same size and stock this year.
values: Locally made, built to last. Provenance and construction over logos, and partnerships that stay neighbourly.

palette_rules.distribution: Every hang tag is a solid Oat Cotton ground, as on northgrove_hangtag.pdf, and Oat Cotton is the lookbook's page ground. The lookbook cover, like every hang tag, is a solid Oat Cotton ground; Charcoal panels sit on the lookbook's inner pages only. On Oat Cotton, the wordmark, style names, titles, heads, body copy, prices and fine print are Charcoal, and the colourway line and small labels may be Workshop Olive, as on northgrove_hangtag.pdf. On Charcoal, all type is Oat Cotton. The leaf glyph is always Workshop Olive. Forge Rust and Cast Pewter are for rules, dividers and keylines only, together no more than 5% of the designed, non-photographic area.
palette_rules.opacity: Every palette colour is used solid, at 100% opacity. No tint, transparency, gradient, shadow or blend mode is applied to any palette colour, and no scrim, gradient or overlay of any colour, black and white included, is laid over a photograph.
palette_rules.forbidden: No colour outside the five palette hexes for type, grounds, panels, rules or icons.
palette_rules.photography: Photographs keep their own corrected colour and are never recoloured toward the palette: a garment whose colourway shares a palette name (Charcoal, Workshop Olive, Oat Cotton, Forge Rust, Cast Pewter) keeps its own cloth colour. The ten flat-lays, northgrove_flatlay_01.jpg to northgrove_flatlay_10.jpg, read as one shoot on one neutral mid gray backdrop, as the brand assets note describes the shoot (flat, overhead, on a mid gray backdrop). The cast hardware in northgrove_hardware_01.jpg, northgrove_hardware_02.jpg, northgrove_hardware_03.jpg and northgrove_hardware_04.jpg keeps true metal tone with no cast, as northgrove_copy.txt asks. The Kestrel Lane crest from kestrel_pennant.jpg is the club's mark, not a NORTHGROVE design element, and may keep its own thread colours.
